target_development_information: Additional labeled target patients, explicitly extra supervision; all Base/Shared/Specific receive same access; never overlap original test patients. Developed versions marked dagger.

target_development_selection.sepsis: 4096 uniform unused raw patients per hospital, seed0; retrospective 1:1 eligible cases/controls, same task as previous casecontrol
target_development_selection.readmission: Up to4096 target patients outside existing OOD test; uniform without replacement seed0; original natural prevalence

source_inputs: Original prepared source train and calibration, preprocessor source-fitted exactly as before
methods: TabICL-v2 frozen weights;256rows/branch;1native-estimator. Base dagger uses one development-selected source/target mixed random context; Shared five context roles, Specific retains Shared+three target roles. Any extra adaptors explicitly marked new development variants.
selection_metric: Development-validation Acc only; no test sorting/range enforcement
statistical_claim: Single seed exploratory development; previously observed final test cohorts, no new confirmatory generalization claim
test_evaluation: All selected policies frozen before opening final labels in new evaluator; retain old results and report matched Base dagger and original Base
development_split_detail: 60% outer fit split subdivided 2:1 into context patients and fusion calibration patients; outer validation40% only ranks candidates. Source and target calibration clinically labeled; target calibration shares .25,.5,1 available to ALL methods.
hierarchical_residual: Specific fusion anchors at selected Shared and retains its bank. It may fall back unchanged; no strict test ranking is imposed.
